and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.
but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’

But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war, and have shed blood.’
When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men…
You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says…
For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of Yahweh his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until Yahweh put his enemies under the soles of his feet.
translations.bsb: “As you are well aware, due to the wars waged on all sides against my father David, he could not build a house for the Name of the LORD his God until the LORD had put his enemies under his feet.
translations.kjv: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
translations.asv: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build a house for the name of Jehovah his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until Jehovah put them under the soles of his feet.
